content.text:
I couldn't confirm a live price for a new M4 MacBook Air today. Apple's own pages point to $999 for the 13-inch, but the M4 may no longer be sold new.

- **13-inch M4:** Apple launched it in the US at **$999**, or **$899** with education pricing. The structured data on Apple's Buy MacBook Air page still lists M4 offers at $999 and $1,399. That page text may be cached and out of date.
- **15-inch M4:** It launched at **$1,199**, or **$1,099** with education pricing.
- **M5 is now the headline model:** Apple's main MacBook Air page now features the M5. Its buy pages show higher prices, for example a 15-inch range starting around $1,499. The M4 may have been discontinued or may only be available as leftover stock.
- **Refurbished:** Apple's refurbished store has listed a 13-inch M4, but I couldn't find a current price for it.

To check, open the [Buy MacBook Air page](https://www.apple.com/us/shop/buy-mac/macbook-air) and look for M4 configurations. Or look at the [refurbished MacBook Air page](https://www.apple.com/shop/refurbished/mac/macbook-air) for a cheaper M4.
